description:
Genes co-expressed with a gene, for guessing function and shortlisting candidates (e.g. under a QTL), from
ATTED-II union co-expression (thousands of RNA-seq samples per species; z-score, higher = stronger). For a crop
gene the Arabidopsis orthologue's co-expressed genes are listed, each with its TAIR symbol and description and its
orthologues back in the crop species; soybean genes (GLYMA_...) use soybean's own co-expression where loaded.
gene: an Ensembl gene ID or name of a crop genome here, or an AGI / Arabidopsis name. agi: choose which Arabidopsis
orthologue to use when there are several (default: the first). top: number of partners (max 50).
Co-expression across Arabidopsis samples is evidence about the Arabidopsis gene; the crop copies may differ.
name: coexpressed_genes
